title: OpenAI letter of intent: up to $100 billion as each gigawatt is deployed
insight_template: Nvidia's {headline} letter of intent with {counterparty} has no disclosed definitive agreement; a separate equity purchase followed (analysis), adding no binding exposure.
definition: In September 2025 Nvidia and OpenAI signed a letter of intent under which Nvidia intends to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI progressively as each gigawatt of Nvidia systems is deployed, alongside OpenAI deploying at least 10 GW. Both sides said details were still to be finalized. No definitive agreement for this structure has been disclosed by either side as of 2026-11-23; in February 2026 Nvidia instead committed equity to OpenAI's funding round, recorded separately.

reconciliation.nvidia_side: Nvidia release: intends to invest up to $100 billion progressively (ev_30021). Q3 FY26 10-Q: a letter of intent with an opportunity to invest in OpenAI (ev_10156). FY26 10-K (2026-02-25): finalizing an investment and partnership agreement (ev_10125). Q1 and Q2 FY27 10-Qs do not name OpenAI as an investee.
reconciliation.counterparty_side: OpenAI release of the same date: NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100 billion progressively (ev_120020), details to be finalized (ev_120021). OpenAI has published nothing since that converts the letter of intent into a definitive agreement; its February 2026 round release describes a separate $30 billion investment.

differences.nvidia_value: 10-K of 2026-02-25 says an agreement was being finalized; later 10-Qs silent
differences.counterparty_value: No statement since September 2025

credit.wwr_reason: No binding exposure. If converted, equity value would fall with AI demand and OpenAI's funding conditions, but the amount would not grow with distress.
credit.notes: Tier 2 reporting (not quotable here) said the letter of intent was stalled in early 2026 and that the February 2026 investment was separate from it. Listed under Needs quote in the R5 report.

first_order.trigger: OpenAI deploys gigawatts of Nvidia systems without a definitive investment agreement
first_order.mechanism: The letter of intent lapses in practice and Nvidia's cash stays uncommitted
first_order.text: The letter of intent ties Nvidia's investment to each gigawatt OpenAI deploys; if OpenAI keeps deploying Nvidia systems without a signed agreement, Nvidia gains the sales without investing (analysis).

first_order.trigger: Nvidia and OpenAI sign a definitive agreement on the gigawatt structure
first_order.mechanism: Nvidia would owe equity to OpenAI as each gigawatt is deployed
first_order.text: If Nvidia and OpenAI signed the letter's terms, investment released progressively as each gigawatt is deployed would become a commitment tied to OpenAI's own purchases of Nvidia systems (analysis).

second_order.mechanism: OpenAI's suppliers and lessors price OpenAI's capacity to pay on a commitment that does not bind Nvidia
second_order.text: OpenAI and Nvidia said only that they look forward to finalizing the details, so lessors and clouds serving OpenAI cannot count the letter's headline as funding for OpenAI (analysis).

title: Guaranties of OpenAI's PORTS-Pike leases from SB Energy, capped at $105 billion
insight_template: Nvidia guarantees {counterparty}'s lease value at an Ohio campus up to {contingent_max} once buildings are ready, so it pays exactly when {counterparty} cannot.
definition: On 2026-08-17 Nvidia entered into residual value guaranties with SB Energy, the lessor, covering about 4.25 GW of IT load leased for 20 years to an affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC at the PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio. Nvidia pays only if OpenAI's tenant defaults (insolvency or an uncured monetary default); each guaranty takes effect when its building is ready for service, the first expected in Nvidia's fiscal 2029, and the guaranteed amount declines as OpenAI pays rent. The aggregate cap is $105 billion; the guaranties end on OpenAI reaching a designated credit rating, at lease end, or after 20 years, and OpenAI must reimburse Nvidia. The tenant is VELA I Holdings, LLC, whose parent OpenAI Global, LLC guarantees its obligations by joinder; OpenAI's non-payment is the trigger, so the exposure is recorded against OpenAI, and SB Energy's building subsidiaries are the beneficiaries.

contingent_max.trigger: Insolvency of the OpenAI tenant or an uncured monetary default under a PORTS-Pike lease, after the building is ready for service; Nvidia pays the shortfall against a guaranteed minimum value that declines over each 20-year lease, net of reletting or sale.
contingent_max.effective_note: Not in force: each guaranty takes effect only when its PORTS-Pike building is completed and ready for service; the first is expected in Nvidia's fiscal 2029 (ev_120002, ev_120009). No payments have been made (ev_30023).

reconciliation.nvidia_side: 8-K and 10-Q: guaranties capped at $105 billion for about 4.25 GW, nine phases, first effective in fiscal 2029, triggered by tenant default, exposure declines as OpenAI pays, terminates on a satisfactory OpenAI credit rating, OpenAI reimburses Nvidia, option on about 3.8 GW more (ev_30001, ev_30009, ev_10040, ev_120001, ev_120002, ev_120005, ev_30007, ev_30008, ev_30004). No payments made to date (ev_30023).
reconciliation.counterparty_side: OpenAI: secures about 8 GW-IT; 20-year lease; NVIDIA provides credit support for the initial 4.25 IT-GW; rent starts only as completed capacity is delivered (ev_120022, ev_120025, ev_120024, ev_120023). SB Energy S-1/A: aggregate guaranteed value and remedy cap of $105 billion on the initial 4.25 GW-IT; trigger is tenant insolvency or an uncured monetary default; OpenAI compensates NVIDIA under a separate agreement; 17 leases for about 8.0 GW-IT commencing 2028 to 2032 (ev_40089, ev_40090, ev_40091, ev_40094, ev_40098, ev_40099).

differences.counterparty_value: remaining 3.78 GW-IT (SB Energy S-1/A)

differences.counterparty_value: Compensation provided separately by OpenAI under a separate agreement, amount not disclosed (SB Energy)
OpenAI must secure a replacement guarantor rated at least A- (SB Energy)

credit.collateral: No security for Nvidia. The landlord must pursue the tenant parent concurrently (ev_100050) and Nvidia looks solely to the tenant and tenant parent for recoupment (ev_100003). On a trigger Nvidia may assume the tenancy, have the landlord re-let, or sell (ev_40096); recovery depends on reletting a campus purpose-built for Nvidia infrastructure. OpenAI's reimbursement and indemnity is an unsecured claim on the defaulted tenant (ev_30008, ev_120007).
credit.tenor: Over 10 years: up to 20 years per building from each lease commencement, leases commencing 2028 to 2032; no guaranty is in force before the first building is ready, expected in Nvidia's fiscal 2029.
credit.notes: Not effective yet: no building is ready for service; exposure builds building by building and then declines (ev_120009). The guaranties are limited to defined portions of lease and power payments (ev_120003). Nvidia's option on the remaining capacity is at its sole discretion and carries no stated amount.
